lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns. Approximately 4-5 spots per column are visible in the mid-flank area posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the upper edge and defined shadows on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller, high-luminance blobs compared to the spacing on the lateral flank. Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible in the ventral-pectoral region.
